name: Gasthof Feldwebel
beschreibung: The Gasthof Feldwebel is a traditional hotel located in the village of Söll in Tyrol. Centrally situated in town, it provides quick and easy access to local shops and restaurants. The welcoming ambiance is characterised by authentic Tyrolean hospitality and cosy interiors. Guests can enjoy a restaurant featuring regional cuisine and a generous breakfast buffet. The surroundings offer splendid views of the surrounding peaks and the picturesque Sölllandl countryside. Amenities include modern rooms with private bathrooms and, in select rooms, balconies. A sauna area is available for unwinding after active days outdoors. Hiking paths and ski slopes are easily reached from the property.
